integrity: Exact integer and rational computations are reproducible from the bundled checker; the general proof uses toric semigroup geometry and rational Ehrhart theory. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the K-polystable toric central variety, not automatically to K-stable nearby deformations.
Anticanonical maps are rational maps; no global basepoint-freeness asserted.
Minimal algebra generators determined, not all relations or syzygies.
title: The thirteen-generator anticanonical ring of an octagonal-prism toric Fano threefold
